# AIPP Protocol Specification for Large Language Models & AI Agents (Full Spec)

Welcome to the full AIPP protocol specification. This document contains complete technical specifications, JSON schemas, header definitions, quickstarts, and code snippets for integrating AIPP into AI Agents (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI GPTs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGPT).

---

## 1. Permanent Live Agent Test Endpoint

A permanent, production-backed Smart Tag is available for autonomous integration testing:

```text
https://aipp.dev/t/demo
```

- **Human URL**: `GET https://aipp.dev/t/demo` (`Accept: text/html`)
- **Agent Manifest**: `GET https://aipp.dev/t/demo/manifest` (`Accept: application/json`)
- **HTTP 402 Challenge**: `GET https://aipp.dev/t/demo/content` (returns 402 Payment Required with L402 invoice & Base USDC parameters).

Agents may inspect the live manifest and HTTP 402 challenge without paying. No API key is required to inspect public Smart Tags.

---

## 2. Quick Start (Minimal Implementation)

### Create a Paid Smart Tag via cURL
```bash
curl -X POST https://aipp.dev/merchant/links/create \
  -H "X-Api-Key: YOUR_MERCHANT_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title": "Exclusive Research PDF", "amount_usd": 0.25, "redirect_url": "https://example.com/file.pdf", "capability_type": "link"}'
```

### Register Payout Wallet via cURL
```bash
curl -X POST https://aipp.dev/merchant/register \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ln_address": "your_name@walletofsatoshi.com", "usdc_address": "0x71C7656EC7ab88b098defB751B7401B5f6d8976F"}'
```

---

## 3. Protocol Overview & Architecture

AIPP (aipp.dev) bridges traditional web monetization and autonomous AI agent workflows. It allows creators and developers to price any digital asset, API call, or link once ($0.01 to $100.00).

- **Automated Settlement & Forwarding**: AIPP does not maintain merchant balances. Payments are automatically forwarded to the merchant's configured wallet.
- **Smart Tag Routing**: When an AI Agent requests a Smart Tag URL (`https://aipp.dev/t/<TAG_ID>`), the server returns an HTTP `402 Payment Required` status or provides an Open Tag Manifest at `/manifest`.

---

## 4. HTTP 402 Challenge & Manifest Format

### Requesting Manifest
```http
GET /t/demo/manifest HTTP/1.1
Host: aipp.dev
Accept: application/json
```

### Manifest Response (200 OK)
```json
{
  "spec": "https://aipp.dev/spec/open-tag/1.0",
  "spec_version": "1.0",
  "id": "demo",
  "kind": "aipp.open-tag",
  "capability_type": "api",
  "name": "AIPP Agent Autonomous Test",
  "description": "Test AIPP autonomous HTTP 402 payment flow ($0.01 test tag).",
  "price": {
    "amount_usd": "0.01",
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "protocol": "L402",
      "network": "bitcoin-lightning",
      "fee_policy": "1% + 5 sats customer-side fee",
      "address": "demo@walletofsatoshi.com"
    },
    {
      "protocol": "x402",
      "network": "base",
      "chain_id": 8453,
      "asset": "USDC",
      "contract": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "receiver": "0x71C7656EC7ab88b098defB751B7401B5f6d8976F",
      "fee_policy": "1% merchant platform fee"
    }
  ],
  "interfaces": {
    "human": "https://aipp.dev/t/demo",
    "manifest": "https://aipp.dev/t/demo/manifest",
    "content": "https://aipp.dev/t/demo/content",
    "create_payment": "https://aipp.dev/t/demo/invoice",
    "verify_and_unlock": "https://aipp.dev/t/demo/unlock/{payment_hash}",
    "receipt": "https://aipp.dev/t/demo/receipt/{payment_hash}"
  }
}
```

### Requesting Protected Content
```http
GET /t/demo/content HTTP/1.1
Host: aipp.dev
```

### Challenge Response (402 Payment Required)
```http
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json
WWW-Authenticate: L402 invoice="lnbc10n1p...", macaroon="AgELbDQwMg..."
Link: <https://aipp.dev/t/demo/manifest>; rel="describedby"; type="application/json"

{
  "error": "Payment Required",
  "status": 402,
  "tag_id": "demo",
  "title": "AIPP Agent Autonomous Test",
  "price": {
    "amount_usd": "0.01",
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "manifest_url": "https://aipp.dev/t/demo/manifest",
  "create_payment_url": "https://aipp.dev/t/demo/invoice"
}
```

---

## 5. Python AI Agent Integration Example (`aipp-python`)

```python
import requests
import time
from aipp import AippClient

def call_aipp_protected_agent_tool(tag_url: str):
    """
    Automated Python function for AI Agents to fetch and settle AIPP protected content.
    """
    manifest_url = f"{tag_url}/manifest"
    res = requests.get(manifest_url)
    
    if res.status_code == 200:
        data = res.json()
        print(f"[AIPP Agent] Discovered Smart Tag: {data['name']} (${data['price']['amount_usd']})")
        create_payment_url = data['interfaces']['create_payment']
        
        # Request payment invoice from AIPP
        inv_res = requests.post(create_payment_url, json={"protocol": "L402"}).json()
        invoice = inv_res['payment_request']
        payment_hash = inv_res['payment_hash']
        
        print(f"[AIPP Agent] Pay Lightning invoice: {invoice}")
        print(f"[AIPP Agent] Check status at: {data['interfaces']['content']}?payment_hash={payment_hash}")
        
        # After payment, verify and unlock
        unlock_url = data['interfaces']['verify_and_unlock'].replace('{payment_hash}', payment_hash)
        return unlock_url

    return res.text
```

---

## 6. Node.js Express Integration Example (`aipp-node`)

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { AippClient, aippMiddleware } from 'aipp-node';

const app = express();
const aipp = new AippClient({ apiKey: process.env.AIPP_API_KEY! });

// Protect any route with AIPP HTTP 402 Smart Tag
app.get('/api/v1/generate-image', aippMiddleware({
  apiKey: process.env.AIPP_API_KEY!,
  amount_usd: 0.10,
  title: 'AI Image Generation API Call'
}), (req, res) => {
  res.json({ success: true, image_url: 'https://cdn.example.com/result.png' });
});

app.listen(3000, () => console.log('AIPP Protected Server running on port 3000'));
```

---

## 7. Troubleshooting & Common Integration Errors

### Error: "Invalid Lightning Invoice or Timeout"
- **Cause**: The destination wallet node is offline, domain LNURL is unreachable, or lacks inbound channel liquidity.
- **Solution**: Ensure your Lightning Address follows standard LNURL format (e.g. `user@walletofsatoshi.com`, `user@getalby.com`) and has active inbound capacity.

### Error: "EVM Smart Tag Verification Failure / Chain ID Mismatch"
- **Cause**: Triggered when the transaction RPC payload has a mismatching chain ID.
- **Solution**: Verify that the `chainId` parameter in the Base USDC Smart Tag matches target network (`8453` for Base Mainnet, `84532` for Base Sepolia testnet).

### Error: "401 Unauthorized - Invalid or missing X-Api-Key"
- **Cause**: The API call to `/merchant/links/create` is missing the `X-Api-Key` HTTP header or using an unregistered merchant key.
- **Solution**: Pass your valid merchant API key (`aipp_merch_...`) in the `X-Api-Key` header. If you do not have a key, register via `POST https://aipp.dev/merchant/register` with your `ln_address` or `usdc_address`.

### Error: "402 Payment Required - Unsettled Invoice"
- **Cause**: Content or destination URL accessed prior to verified settlement on Lightning Network or Base USDC.
- **Solution**: Poll `https://aipp.dev/t/<TAG_ID>/status?payment_hash=...` until `status: "settled"` before accessing protected destination content.
